text: Galia Rautenberg wow, if you lived in China for over 20 years, you are the ones who enjoyed the superior benefits of the more open and developing China. The treatment in daily life that Chinese people give to foriegners are unbelievable sincere and warm. All countries have flaws in administrative work related to foreign immigration matters, but to describe this experience as "20 years in China, without any rights" here is really not giving you any strong arguments for why we shouldn't fight for the basic rights as foreigners living in Israel.
